title: Modeling Users and Online Communities for Abuse Detection: A Position on Ethics and Explainability
benchmark_measurement: Detection of hate speech and stereotypes targeting religious groups, used as an example for abuse detection.
findings: The paper uses anti-Muslim hate speech as a specific example to illustrate how prevailing stereotypes can motivate online abuse. It also uses a hypothetical scenario of an insult directed at a religious group to argue that user and community context is essential for correctly interpreting potentially abusive language, distinguishing implicit slurs from other meanings.
